metadata.title: Game Engine Workshop
metadata.description: Turn-based game engine — workshop bootstrap for "AI Generation in practice".

home.title: Turn-based <accent>game engine</accent>
home.lead: One engine, two reference games, four AI agent roles. Pick a game and start a match — state is saved to data/matches/[id].json.
home.footer: Architecture: a game-agnostic engine (packages/engine/), games as modules (packages/games/*/). Adding a third game = a new folder, zero engine changes — see ADR 0001.

match.title: Match
match.missingGameBody: This match points to game {gameId}, which is not in the registry (apps/web/lib/games-registry.ts). Check whether the package packages/games/{gameId}/ is registered.
